payload.claim: NordPass uses XChaCha20 with zero-knowledge architecture and its architecture has been independently audited
payload.quote: Built by the team behind NordVPN, it uses XChaCha20 encryption with a zero-knowledge architecture, so NordPass itself cannot read your vault, and its security architecture has been independently audited.

payload.claim: NordPass Family costs 3.69 USD/month on a one-year term, less on two-year, and renews higher
payload.quote: The Family plan costs $3.69 a month on a one-year term and less on a two-year term, though, like most vendors, NordPass raises the price at renewal, so budget for that in year two.

payload.claim: NordPass syncs across iPhone, Android and Windows
payload.quote: cross-platform syncing means every family member can use their preferred device — iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, Mac, you name it.

payload.claim: 1Password publishes regular independent audits incl Cure53 and holds SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001
payload.quote: Audit history: 1Password publishes results from regular independent security audits, including Cure53 penetration tests, and holds SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certifications.

payload.claim: 1Password Families is 5.99 USD/month for five people (4.49 promo)
payload.quote: Families is $5.99 per month for five people ($4.49 promotional).

payload.claim: RoboForm Family covers five users at about 1.59/month, AES-256 zero-knowledge, SOC 2 Type 2, third-party audit, no reported breach in ~25 years
payload.quote: Its Family plan covers five users and is currently promoted at about $1.59 a month, it uses AES-256 encryption with a zero-knowledge model, holds SOC 2 Type 2 and has passed a third-party security audit, all with no reported breach in roughly 25 years.

payload.claim: Cure53 Jan 2026 audit of Bitwarden flagged two critical vulnerabilities in extension autofill isolation
payload.quote: More concerning, Cure53's January 2026 audit of Bitwarden flagged two critical-severity vulnerabilities in the browser extension's autofill isolation, and the fixes were still rolling out to some clients months later.

payload.claim: Cure53 Jan 2026 audit of Bitwarden found zero critical vulnerabilities
payload.quote: 2026 Security Audit Results: Bitwarden underwent independent security audits by Cure53 in January 2026, passing all penetration testing with zero critical vulnerabilities.
The Family plan at $40/year for 6 users ($6.67/user) represents exceptional value.

payload.claim: Bitwarden is open source with multiple independent audits
payload.quote: Open-source codebase with multiple independent security audits, enabling verification rather than trust

payload.claim: ICO fined LastPass UK 1.2m pounds Nov 2025 over the 2022 incident
payload.quote: In November 2025 the UK Information Commissioner's Office fined LastPass UK Ltd £1.2 million for failing to put appropriate security measures in place, finding that the 2022 incident affected up to 1.6 million UK users.

payload.claim: June 2026 LastPass Klue breach exposed customer data but reportedly not vaults
payload.quote: Customer vaults and LastPass infrastructure were reportedly unaffected.

payload.claim: Keeper has SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP High and no vault breach; Family 91.99/yr for 5 users
payload.quote: Keeper is the most heavily certified platform, with SOC 2, ISO 27001 and FedRAMP High authorization for its government cloud, and it has never had a breach of its encrypted vaults.

payload.claim: Dashlane removed free tier Sep 2025 and has less published audit detail
payload.quote: Dashlane All-in-one bundle with VPN No (removed Sep 2025) $4.99/mo Friends and Family $7.49/mo, 10 users Less published audit detail

payload.claim: NordPass renewal comes with price increase
payload.quote: Renewal comes with a price increase

payload.claim: 1Password Families renews at 9.99/month after first-year promotion, no free tier
payload.quote: The catch is cost: there is no free tier, only a 14-day trial, the Families plan covers five people, and once the first-year promotion ends it renews at $9.99 a month, which makes it the priciest mainstream option for a family of four.
The Secret Key never leaves your devices and is never sent to 1Password's servers.
